verdict.rationale: Convex's CLI is documented to run headlessly (probe confirms `npx convex --version` and MCP handshake work keylessly) and supports pushing schema/function code (`convex dev`, `convex deploy`, `convex run`, `convex import`) which an agent could invoke from a script, and Convex explicitly markets itself as agent-friendly (docs-20, docs-23) with schema-as-code (docs-3) and pluggable auth providers (docs-4, docs-5, docs-15, docs-16). However there is no first-party example of a single non-interactive script that scaffolds schema, auth, and authorization policies together — auth setup (Clerk/Convex Auth) and policy code appear to require manual file authoring rather than a scripted CLI flow, and no explicit 'convex init --headless' or similar all-in-one command is documented. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end headless script combining schema+auth+policy provisioning, explicit non-interactive flags for auth/policy setup, and independent hands-on confirmation of a full automated bootstrap.
